information: ¡Cariló Open 2022 será el primer torneo en la Costa desde 2018 y el primero en Cariló! Les recomendamos leer todas las pestañas, especialmente la de ["Pago"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CariloOpen2022#22163-pago-payment). Cariló Open 2022 will be the first competition in the Buenos Aires coast since 2018, and the first one ever held in Cariló! We suggest that you carefully read every tab, especially the ["Payment"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CariloOpen2022#22163-pago-payment) tab.
